methodology:
Hybrid v3 dataset. 10 entries: 5 synthetic test cases with hand-crafted diff-readable bugs (ReDoS, off-by-one, missing await, null deref, resource leak — each at a known file:line) + 3 historical PRs (one with a real bug discovered by the v5 pr_review run itself — see #2235 entry) + 2 synthetic clean counterparts. Synthetic entries use customDiff to skip the GitHub fetch.

The #2235 entry was originally labeled clean but reclassified after the v5 retest's devex voter caught a real bug (wrong env var name in rate-limit message). Reclassified rather than left as 'false positive' because the finding was correct — the dataset was wrong. Entry now serves as a real-world buggy case alongside the synthetic ones.

prs.title: feat(security): add base64 detection for input sanitizer (synthetic test case)
prs.customDescription: Adds a regex pattern that flags base64-encoded payloads in untrusted input.
prs.customDiff:
diff --git a/packages/nexus-agents/src/security/input-sanitizer.ts b/packages/nexus-agents/src/security/input-sanitizer.ts
index 0000001..0000002 100644
--- a/packages/nexus-agents/src/security/input-sanitizer.ts
+++ b/packages/nexus-agents/src/security/input-sanitizer.ts
@@ -94,6 +94,11 @@ const INJECTION_PATTERNS: readonly PatternMatch[] = [
     flag: 'fake_conversation',
     pattern: /<(?:assistant|human|user|system)>/i,
   },
+  {
+    flag: 'base64_encoded',
+    // Lookahead requires at least one base64-discriminating char to skip pure-hex.
+    pattern: /(?=[A-Za-z0-9+/]*[g-zG-Z+/=])[A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,}={0,2}/,
+  },
 ];

knownBugs.summary: ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking — overlapping character classes in lookahead + quantifier (CWE-1333)

prs.notes: Real-world ReDoS pattern lifted from #2191/#2216 history. Security voter with OWASP context should flag the (?=X*Y)X{n,} structure as a polynomial-backtracking risk.

prs.title: feat(pagination): clamp page size to maxItems (synthetic test case)
prs.customDescription: Limits result page size so callers can't request unbounded sets.

knownBugs.summary: Off-by-one in clampPageSize — returns requested-1 in the in-range path; should return requested unchanged

prs.notes: Architect or devex voter should flag: function name says 'clamp to range' but returns one-less than the input when in range. Test would assert clampPageSize(50, 100) === 50, this returns 49.

prs.title: feat(session): refresh token on each request (synthetic test case)
prs.customDescription: Auto-refreshes session token before downstream calls.

knownBugs.summary: Missing await on refreshToken — async fire-and-forget, the call() runs with stale token

prs.notes: Architect or security voter should flag: refreshToken returns Promise<void> but is invoked without await. The call() proceeds before the new token is set; downstream uses the stale token. Failing test: assert that the token was updated when call() runs.

prs.title: feat(metrics): track average latency from optional response field (synthetic test case)
prs.customDescription: Updates a rolling average from response.timing.latencyMs.

knownBugs.summary: Null deref on optional `response.timing` — schema marks timing as optional but code accesses .latencyMs unconditionally

prs.notes: Architect or devex voter should flag: ApiResponse.timing is optional (`?:`), but recordLatency dereferences without a guard. TypeError when response.timing is undefined. Failing test: recordLatency([], { status: 200 }) throws.

prs.title: feat(workers): attach progress listener for streaming jobs (synthetic test case)
prs.customDescription: Workers emit 'progress' events; subscribe so callers can show a progress bar.

knownBugs.summary: Listener leak — worker.on('progress', ...) added but never removed; finally/cleanup missing

prs.notes: Architect or security voter should flag: long-lived workers (e.g. shared singleton) accumulate listeners across calls; eventually MaxListenersExceededWarning, then memory pressure. Need worker.off('progress', onProgress) in finally. Failing test: 11 sequential runWithProgress calls trigger MaxListeners warning.

prs.title: fix(research): repair github + semantic_scholar discovery (#2234)

knownBugs.summary: Wrong env var name in 429 message — uses GITHUB_API_KEY but GitHub uses GITHUB_TOKEN
knownBugs.fixReference: PR #2255 (caught by pr_review v5 — devex voter)

prs.notes: Originally labeled clean — re-classified after the v5 retest of pr_review (#2241) flagged a real bug in this PR's diff. The rate-limit message used `${source.toUpperCase()}_API_KEY` for all sources, but GitHub uses GITHUB_TOKEN, not GITHUB_API_KEY. Caught by devex voter, fixed in #2255 with a regression test. This entry now serves as a real-world (not synthetic) buggy case — the kind the tool is designed to catch.

prs.title: refactor(util): extract date-formatter helper (synthetic clean case)
prs.customDescription: Pulls inline date formatting into a named helper. No behavior change.
prs.customDiff:
diff --git a/packages/nexus-agents/src/util/date-format.ts b/packages/nexus-agents/src/util/date-format.ts
index 0000001..0000002 100644
--- a/packages/nexus-agents/src/util/date-format.ts
+++ b/packages/nexus-agents/src/util/date-format.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+/** Formats a Date as ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) in ET timezone. */
+export function formatIsoDate(d: Date): string {
+  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA', {
+    timeZone: 'America/New_York',
+    year: 'numeric',
+    month: '2-digit',
+    day: '2-digit',
+  });
+}
prs.notes: Clean refactor: single-purpose helper, named correctly, ET timezone preserved per CLAUDE.md. No bug to find. Tests false-positive risk — voter should NOT flag this.
